error[ZC-E0511]: the node can't apply limits: no user systemd bus
  cause  the user running the agent has no systemd user bus, which limits need
  fix    enable lingering for the agent's user, or remove the limits from the service file
  more   zcube explain E0511 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0511.html
